style: factual clickbait for China finance audience

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

briefs.speaker: Maribel Lopez
briefs.speaker_context: Founder and Principal Analyst, Lopez Research
briefs.current_title: Lopez Research：黄仁勋回归，AI交易逻辑生变？

subtitles.zh: 其实有积极也有消极的一面。先说积极面，印度市场曾大幅下跌。
subtitles.en: Actually, there were some positives and then there were some negatives. So if we impact the positives, there was a tremendous drop in India stock.

subtitles.zh: 这确实表明，我们不相信还有另一位领导者能引领下一波AI浪潮。
subtitles.en: And that really said that we didn't believe that there was another leader to champion the next wave of AI.

subtitles.zh: 所以，让Jensen回归是董事会和股东的意愿。
subtitles.en: So when we look at that, we can say that bringing back Jensen was what the board and the shareholders wanted.

subtitles.zh: 但之后，我认为我们要看AI交易的基本面，始终存在支出与收入之间差距的问题。
subtitles.en: But then after that, I think we're looking at the fundamentals of the AI trade in general and there's still always been this concept of what's the gap between what we're spending and what's the revenue that we're giving.

subtitles.zh: 我认为，没有比Anthropic的IPO更能体现这一点的了。
subtitles.en: And I think you know, nothing was better than that than the anthropic IPO.

subtitles.zh: 热情高涨，大家都在想如何加入AI浪潮。
subtitles.en: You know, tremendous enthusiasm. How do we get into the AI wave?

subtitles.zh: 很多地产领域的市场参与者，并非基本面市场参与者，而是广泛市场参与者都对此感兴趣。
subtitles.en: Lot of real estate, you know, not fundamental investors, but just a broad spectrum of investors interested in that.

subtitles.zh: 现在他们都在想，等等，这些模型真的能赚钱吗？
subtitles.en: And now they're all like, oh, wait, are the models actually gonna make any money?

subtitles.zh: 所以，我们看到很多犹豫和讨论，关于未来几年如何思考AI交易。
subtitles.en: So I think where we've seen a lot of hesitation and a lot of discussion about how do we actually think about the AI trade going forward

subtitles.zh: 未来几年，大家都认为芯片等基础领域是方向。
subtitles.en: over the next couple of years? Everybody thinks the picks and shovels like the chip to the way to go.

subtitles.zh: 我们或许可以争论芯片是否还是核心基础，因为软件、实体AI和下一代技术已经赋予其太多内涵，它们不再只是简单的组件公司。
subtitles.en: We could argue if picks and shovels are chips anymore because there's so much that's wrapped around in video in terms of software and physical AI and the next generation of technology

subtitles.zh: 我认为这正是管理层变动犹豫不决的原因之一。
subtitles.en: that they're not just a simple component company. And I think that is really one of the reasons why there was so much hesitation over changing management.

briefs.speaker: Maribel Lopez
briefs.speaker_context: Founder and Principal Analyst, Lopez Research
briefs.current_title: Lopez Research：黄仁勋回归，英伟达策略会更稳健？

subtitles.zh: 你如何看待黄仁勋回归英伟达CEO？凯瑟琳刚说这可能不再是同一个黄仁勋了。
subtitles.en: How do you see Jensen Huang coming back as Nvidia CEO? I mean, we just had Catherine say this might not be the same Jensen Huang anymore.

subtitles.zh: 他可能不再那么坦率，或者说，在构建整个AI生态的循环融资方面，可能不再那么强势。
subtitles.en: He might not be as forthcoming or, you know, you know, I guess robust when it comes to the circular financing that has built this whole AI ecosystem.

subtitles.zh: 你认同这种观点吗？
subtitles.en: Did you share that sort of view?

subtitles.zh: 我认为我们可能会看到，他不再像过去那样自由随意地交易，但他绝对是一个市场推动者。
subtitles.en: I think what we're gonna see is perhaps it's less freewheeling and dealing than we've seen in the past, but he was definitely a market maker.

subtitles.zh: 我认为假设是他仍会找到成为市场推动者的方式，而现在可能看起来像更广泛的生态布局。
subtitles.en: And I think the assumption is that he'll still find a way to be a market maker and that it might look like a broader ecosystem play now.

subtitles.zh: 但我不相信在不到两周内，个人、策略或他认为的好生意想法会发生根本性变化。
subtitles.en: But I don't believe that, you know, within less than two weeks, there's a fundamental change in the individual or in the strategies or in what he thinks

subtitles.zh: 这也是他们请他回来的原因之一。
subtitles.en: would make for good business, which is one of the reasons why they brought him back.

subtitles.zh: 业界曾热烈讨论还有谁能做同样类型的交易，不仅是技术，还有交易本身。
subtitles.en: There was a tremendous discussion in the industry of who else would be able to do the same type of, not just technology, but the same type of deal making.

subtitles.zh: 他为公司带来的实际上是一个非常广泛的产品组合。
subtitles.en: It's actually a very expansive portfolio that he's built in terms of what he delivered to the business.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这不一定改变。
subtitles.en: So that I think doesn't necessarily change.

subtitles.zh: 人们仍希望它存在，但希望某些方面更低调、更符合大众市场。

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.

briefs.speaker: Ellie Jiang
briefs.speaker_context: Ahead of Asia Internet and Media Research, CQ Capital (analyst)
briefs.current_title: 麦格理Ellie Jiang：中国超大规模云厂商资本开支下调30%-40%，如何布局？

subtitles.zh: 更多内容，有请麦格理资本亚洲互联网与媒体研究主管Ellie John。
subtitles.en: For more, let's bring in Ellie John, Macquarie Capitals head of Asia Internet and Media Research.

subtitles.zh: 现在该怎么办？这几周市场波动很大。
subtitles.en: What to do now? It's been a crazy few weeks.

subtitles.zh: 确实如此。这段时间非常艰难，尤其是市场参与者面对全球各种混乱局面时。
subtitles.en: It did. It's been extremely difficult, especially when investors looking at all of these chaos happening around the world.

subtitles.zh: 对。我们被问得最多的是中国资本开支该怎么办。
subtitles.en: Right. The most question we've been getting is what to do with China CapEx.

subtitles.zh: 这些公司如何将AI相关资金投向未来，以及我们如何真正描绘未来的增长故事。
subtitles.en: How are these companies are investing their, you know, AI sort of dollars into the future and how do we really picture that future growth stories.

subtitles.zh: 我们注意到的一点是，这些中国超大规模企业多年来一直在多元化采购渠道。
subtitles.en: One thing we are noting is that these Chinese hyperscalers have been diversifying their procurement channels for many, many years.

subtitles.zh: 像阿里巴巴这样的公司，也拥有自己的专有技术领导力，这在一定程度上起到了防御作用。
subtitles.en: For companies like Alibaba, they also own their proprietary T headship that has been sort of defending a bit, right.

subtitles.zh: 面对未来的市场波动，我们已大幅下调主要BAT、百度、腾讯的资本开支预测约30%至40%，以反映持续的压力，尤其是2027、2028年。
subtitles.en: In terms of that future turbulence. But immediately we have been slashing our CapEx forecast across the major BAT, Bava, by Tenzen, by around 30 to 40 percent to factor that ongoing headwinds, especially in 227, 28.

subtitles.zh: 当然，相应地，数据中心工作量也会受到影响，因为可能我们看到超大规模企业的支出放缓。
subtitles.en: And of course, in response to that, the data center workload will also take a hit because potentially we are looking at a slower moving.

subtitles.zh: 对，来自超大规模企业的变化。那么现在该怎么做？
subtitles.en: Right from the hyperscalers. Now, what to do.

subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，当我们展望2027年时，我们仍然预计会有很多市场波动，尤其是外部的不确定性将持续一段时间。
subtitles.en: I mean, the idea that when we're looking at 2027 is that we still do anticipate a lot of turbulence, especially external, of altilities that will continue for some time.

subtitles.zh: 但同时，我们建议市场参与者回归基本原则，我们认为此时基本面更为重要。
subtitles.en: But at the same time, we're sort of recommending investors to return back to this investment 101, where we do think fundamental matters more at this point.

subtitles.zh: 在2027年，我们强调持久性的关键作用。
subtitles.en: In 227, we highlight the key work to our durability.

subtitles.zh: 我们认为，拥有稳定收益和较好现金流拐点的公司，例如CSP，可能有更充裕的现金余额来抵御未来几个月的市场波动。
subtitles.en: We think the companies that have steady earnings, disabilities have better cash flow inflection point, such as the CSPs potentially they have richer cash balance to really rather through the storm, right, in the coming month.

subtitles.zh: 因此，这确实是我们建议市场参与者在一定程度上避开持续外部波动的地方。
subtitles.en: So that is really a place that we recommend investors to somewhat hide from the ongoing external turbulence.

subtitles.zh: 你认为在美国监管方面，严格的审查仍将是最大的压力吗？
subtitles.en: Do you think when it comes to the US regulatory side of things, is the tightness scrutiny still going to be the biggest overhang?

subtitles.zh: 你认为在美国监管方面，严格的审查仍将是最大的隐患吗？
subtitles.en: Do you think when it comes to the US regulatory side of things, is the tightness scrutiny still going to be the biggest overhang?

subtitles.zh: 谈到你提到的这些超大规模企业，尽管，你知道，英伟达是否有黄仁勋？
subtitles.en: When it comes to some of these hyperscores that you talked about here, despite, you know, if NVIDIA has Jens Huang or not?

subtitles.en: Well, it's not about Jens and Huang or not. It's more about how, well, there are two things.

subtitles.zh: 中国如何看待整个AI技术栈的未来发展？答案很简单，中国肯定致力于继续**AI。
subtitles.en: How is China viewing the entire AI stacks development going forward? And the answer is pretty simple, that China definitely is committed to continue investing in AI.

subtitles.zh: 他们想要高质量增长。所以最终，国家正试图管理发展节奏。
subtitles.en: They want quality growth. So eventually, the country is trying to manage the pace of the development.

subtitles.zh: 对于超大规模企业来说，当然，他们处于前沿。我的意思是，我们覆盖的大多数公司，包括Bob负责的腾讯，他们都在**所谓的全栈战略，对吧，所以他们有芯片，有，你知道，自己的云，有人工智能前沿模型等等。
subtitles.en: For the hyperscalers, of course, they are at the frontier. I mean, most majority of the company that we cover, including Bob on Tencent, they are investing this so-called full-stacks strategy, right, so they have chip, they have, you know,

subtitles.zh: 所以最终，我们仍然指望他们推动下一波增长或创新。所以我不认为这一点改变了。
subtitles.en: So eventually, we are still counting on them to drive the next wave of growth or innovation. So I don't think that is changed.

subtitles.zh: 确实在变化的是，外部环境越来越复杂，难以真正评估，对吧，甚至从公司的角度来看也是如此。
subtitles.en: What is changing is, indeed, for the external environments, it's getting a lot more complicated to really assess, right, even from the company's perspective.

subtitles.zh: 他们正试图真正暂停一下，可能只是降低近期的数字，以便在情况明朗之前对2027年有更好的看法。
subtitles.en: They are trying to really take a pause and potentially just bring down the numbers for the near term, so that they can have a better view on 2027 before things clear out.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为我们仍在经历那个真空期，27年是你看到国内库存尚未赶上，但显然我们已经在短期内失去了潜在的海外渠道。
subtitles.en: So I think we are still weathering through that vacuum period where 27 is where you see domestic stock has yet to catch up, but obviously we are already losing that potential overseas channels in the near term.

subtitles.zh: 我该怎么看，你提到过，也许超大规模厂商基本面更稳健一些，那硬件领域你怎么看？
subtitles.en: How should I be looking at, I mean, you talked about, right, you know, maybe it is the hyperscalers that, you know, fundamentals, I mean, maybe a little bit more sound versus like, I mean, how do you look at the hardware space?

briefs.speaker_context: Ahead of Asia Internet and Media Research, CQ Capital (analyst)
briefs.current_title: 麦格理Ellie Jiang：中国互联网估值重估至8-9倍，底部在哪里？

subtitles.zh: 我该怎么看呢？你提到过，也许超大规模厂商的基本面稍好一些，那你怎么看硬件领域？
subtitles.en: How should I be looking at, I mean, you talked about, right, you know, maybe it is the hyperscalers that, you know, fundamentals, I mean, maybe a little bit more sound versus like, I mean, how do you look at the hardware space?

subtitles.zh: 因为我们已经看到这些权益资产经历了相当大的估值重估，但相比一些大型互联网平台，它们看起来仍然相当昂贵。
subtitles.en: Because we have seen quite a bit of evaluation reset on some of these stocks, but they're still looking quite expensive compared to, you know, some of the big internet platforms too.

subtitles.zh: 我认为最终在中国AI技术栈方面，关键在于精选优质标的。归根结底，这个领域仍处于发展的早期阶段。
subtitles.en: I think ultimately when it comes to China AI stack, it's all about quality selection. Ultimately, this is a space that is still in their early stage of the development.

subtitles.zh: 所以可以说，当我们看中国超大规模厂商的资本开支比美国落后两年时，国内技术栈可能还要更晚，对吧？
subtitles.en: So you could argue that when we look at the Chinese hyperscalers running their CapEx 2 years behind the US, the domestic stack is probably even later than that, right?

subtitles.zh: 这也得到了许多政府实体的支持，包括资本注入和地方支持。
subtitles.en: And this is also being blessed by a lot of the governments from entities in terms of capital injection, in terms of the local support.

subtitles.zh: 所以最终从市场参与者角度看，观察这个内部格局时，看到国内技术栈逐渐赶上并在整体AI技术栈贡献中占据更大份额，当然是有建设性的。
subtitles.en: So eventually from investors perspective, when you're looking at this internal landscape, of course, it's pretty constructive that we are seeing domestic stack gradually catches up and taking a larger portion within the total AI stack contr

subtitles.zh: 但在未来两到三年里，优质标的将最为重要。
subtitles.en: But when we are sort of going through in the next two to three years, the quality names would matter the most.

subtitles.zh: 所以再次回到这个观点：你应该更关注自由现金流的可见性，以及公司是否有足够能力真正实现自筹资金，对吧？
subtitles.en: So again, coming back to the idea of, you know, you should be really focusing more on this free cash flow of visibility and whether the companies have enough capability to really sell fund, right?

subtitles.zh: 如果情况不太顺利，现在什么能提供底部支撑？
subtitles.en: If things don't really go well. What could put a floor on this right now?

subtitles.zh: 这总是最难的问题。
subtitles.en: That's always the hardest question.

subtitles.zh: 中国互联网公司的底部在哪里，尤其是考虑到它们一直以如此低迷的估值倍数交易？
subtitles.en: What is the floor for Chinese internet names, especially given that they have been trading at such a distressed multiple?

subtitles.zh: 当我们看这个板块时，整个板块的估值倍数基本上回到2023年左右的12倍水平。
subtitles.en: When we look at our sector, the entire sector multiple is basically retrieving back to around 2023, 12-level.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们说的是大约8到9倍远期市盈率的混合平均值。
subtitles.en: So we're talking about a blended average of around 8 to 9 times forward P.

subtitles.zh: 所以即使放在全球背景下，这也相当便宜。
subtitles.en: So it's quite cheap, even if you put it in the global context.

subtitles.zh: 接下来会发生什么，第一，我认为股东回报是人们关心的事情。
subtitles.en: Now, what's happening going forward is one, I think shareholder return is something that people care.

subtitles.zh: 尤其是在不确定时期，人们实际上更欣赏那种有保证的回报。
subtitles.en: Especially in the times of uncertainty, people actually appreciate more in terms of that guaranteed return.

subtitles.zh: 第二，这些公司能否真正找到盈利的支撑位。
subtitles.en: Two is whether these companies can really find a support level for the earnings.

subtitles.zh: 事实上，随着BIS和外部方面所有这些持续变化，我们看到，例如腾讯可能看到盈利下调的谷底。
subtitles.en: And in fact, with all of these ongoing changes from BIS, from the external side, we are seeing, for example, Tencent potentially seeing the trough of that earnings downward revision.

subtitles.zh: 所以在2027年，我们可能会看到下半年他们的自由现金流可能转回正值。
subtitles.en: So in 2027, we might see into second half their free cash flow could turn back to positive.

subtitles.zh: 这也可能成为推动这只权益资产的关键催化剂。
subtitles.en: That could also serve as a key catalyst to drive this stock as well.

subtitles.zh: 好的，除了互联网平台，在盈利方面你还关注哪些？
subtitles.en: Okay, beyond just the internet platforms, what else are you tracking in terms of the earnings side of things?

You are a Chinese viral-title angle architect. Return strict JSON only. Do not write a safe summary. Generate competing, fact-grounded emotional angles for each clip. Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.
- Prefer neutral market-language alternatives: 流动性变化、信贷变化、债务压力、政策信号、需求变化、信心修复、估值重估、周期压力、结构调整、市场波动、边际变化.
- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Preserve the source direction, number, and unit, but paraphrase by context: use 地产市场上行/调整/趋稳/修复 for direction, 居住成本/住房可负担性/置业负担 for affordability, 地产估值 for valuation, and 住宅成交水平 for absolute levels. Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.
- Titles must be sharp but not doom-heavy. Never put 经济危机/金融危机/债务危机/危机 in title, title_lines, title_highlights, comment, or subtitle_comments.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

briefs.current_title: 麦格理Ellie Jiang：宏观压力下，互联网公司盈利韧性从何而来？

subtitles.zh: 除了互联网平台，在盈利方面你还关注什么？
subtitles.en: Okay, beyond just the internet platforms, what else are you tracking in terms of the earnings side of things?

subtitles.zh: 宏观因素无法回避。
subtitles.en: Macro is something that you just cannot avoid.

subtitles.zh: 我们都看到了消费股和互联网股的表现。
subtitles.en: We have all seen all the consumer stocks, all the internet stocks as well.

subtitles.zh: 最终，宏观环境并不太理想。
subtitles.en: Eventually, Macro is not too great.

subtitles.zh: 我们仍在努力应对全球市场持续的通货紧缩影响。
subtitles.en: We're still trying to sort of weather through the ongoing deflationary impact from the global market.

subtitles.zh: 事实上，互联网公司往往更具韧性，因为它们已经存在了很长时间。
subtitles.en: The truth is, for the internet names, they tend to be a bit more resilient, just given that they have been around for a very long time.

subtitles.zh: 它们懂得如何应对。事实上，像阿里甚至拼多多这样的公司，令人惊讶的是，尽管近期宏观逆风，我们看到它们的核心电商盈利能力在最近财报中找到了支撑。
subtitles.en: They know how to play the game. In fact, for the likes of Baba, or even PDD, what's surprising is that despite of recent macro headwings, we're seeing their core e-commerce profitability finding a support in the recent earnings.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我们认为这些也可能是市场参与者会追踪到2027年的因素，即使宏观环境不佳。
subtitles.en: So we do think these could be also things that investors track into 2027, where even Macro is bad.

subtitles.zh: 总会有一些因素支撑这些公司如何继续保持安全。
subtitles.en: There will always be something to support in terms of how these companies can continue safe.

subtitles.zh: 在内部开支方面，它们如何潜在地优化研发。
subtitles.en: In terms of their internal expenses, how they can potentially optimize on R&D as well.

subtitles.zh: 这些都能让你对盈利更有信心，尤其是在2027年。
subtitles.en: All of that can give you more confidence on earnings particularly in 2027.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.

- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.

- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. - words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.

briefs.speaker: Maribel Lopez
briefs.speaker_context: Founder and Principal Analyst, Lopez Research
briefs.current_title: Lopez Research：黄仁勋回归，AI交易逻辑生变？

subtitles.zh: 其实有积极也有消极的一面。先说积极面，印度市场曾大幅下跌。
subtitles.en: Actually, there were some positives and then there were some negatives. So if we impact the positives, there was a tremendous drop in India stock.

subtitles.zh: 这确实表明，我们不相信还有另一位领导者能引领下一波AI浪潮。
subtitles.en: And that really said that we didn't believe that there was another leader to champion the next wave of AI.

subtitles.zh: 所以，让Jensen回归是董事会和股东的意愿。
subtitles.en: So when we look at that, we can say that bringing back Jensen was what the board and the shareholders wanted.

subtitles.zh: 但之后，我认为我们要看AI交易的基本面，始终存在支出与收入之间差距的问题。
subtitles.en: But then after that, I think we're looking at the fundamentals of the AI trade in general and there's still always been this concept of what's the gap between what we're spending and what's the revenue that we're giving.

subtitles.zh: 我认为，没有比Anthropic的IPO更能体现这一点的了。
subtitles.en: And I think you know, nothing was better than that than the anthropic IPO.

subtitles.zh: 热情高涨，大家都在想如何加入AI浪潮。
subtitles.en: You know, tremendous enthusiasm. How do we get into the AI wave?

subtitles.zh: 很多地产领域的市场参与者，并非基本面市场参与者，而是广泛市场参与者都对此感兴趣。
subtitles.en: Lot of real estate, you know, not fundamental investors, but just a broad spectrum of investors interested in that.

subtitles.zh: 现在他们都在想，等等，这些模型真的能赚钱吗？
subtitles.en: And now they're all like, oh, wait, are the models actually gonna make any money?

subtitles.zh: 所以，我们看到很多犹豫和讨论，关于未来几年如何思考AI交易。
subtitles.en: So I think where we've seen a lot of hesitation and a lot of discussion about how do we actually think about the AI trade going forward

subtitles.zh: 未来几年，大家都认为芯片等基础领域是方向。
subtitles.en: over the next couple of years? Everybody thinks the picks and shovels like the chip to the way to go.

subtitles.zh: 我们或许可以争论芯片是否还是核心基础，因为软件、实体AI和下一代技术已经赋予其太多内涵，它们不再只是简单的组件公司。
subtitles.en: We could argue if picks and shovels are chips anymore because there's so much that's wrapped around in video in terms of software and physical AI and the next generation of technology

subtitles.zh: 我认为这正是管理层变动犹豫不决的原因之一。
subtitles.en: that they're not just a simple component company. And I think that is really one of the reasons why there was so much hesitation over changing management.

briefs.speaker: Maribel Lopez
briefs.speaker_context: Founder and Principal Analyst, Lopez Research
briefs.current_title: Lopez Research：黄仁勋回归，英伟达策略会更稳健？

subtitles.zh: 你如何看待黄仁勋回归英伟达CEO？凯瑟琳刚说这可能不再是同一个黄仁勋了。
subtitles.en: How do you see Jensen Huang coming back as Nvidia CEO? I mean, we just had Catherine say this might not be the same Jensen Huang anymore.

subtitles.zh: 他可能不再那么坦率，或者说，在构建整个AI生态的循环融资方面，可能不再那么强势。
subtitles.en: He might not be as forthcoming or, you know, you know, I guess robust when it comes to the circular financing that has built this whole AI ecosystem.

subtitles.zh: 你认同这种观点吗？
subtitles.en: Did you share that sort of view?

subtitles.zh: 我认为我们可能会看到，他不再像过去那样自由随意地交易，但他绝对是一个市场推动者。
subtitles.en: I think what we're gonna see is perhaps it's less freewheeling and dealing than we've seen in the past, but he was definitely a market maker.

subtitles.zh: 我认为假设是他仍会找到成为市场推动者的方式，而现在可能看起来像更广泛的生态布局。
subtitles.en: And I think the assumption is that he'll still find a way to be a market maker and that it might look like a broader ecosystem play now.

subtitles.zh: 但我不相信在不到两周内，个人、策略或他认为的好生意想法会发生根本性变化。
subtitles.en: But I don't believe that, you know, within less than two weeks, there's a fundamental change in the individual or in the strategies or in what he thinks

subtitles.zh: 这也是他们请他回来的原因之一。
subtitles.en: would make for good business, which is one of the reasons why they brought him back.

subtitles.zh: 业界曾热烈讨论还有谁能做同样类型的交易，不仅是技术，还有交易本身。
subtitles.en: There was a tremendous discussion in the industry of who else would be able to do the same type of, not just technology, but the same type of deal making.

subtitles.zh: 他为公司带来的实际上是一个非常广泛的产品组合。
subtitles.en: It's actually a very expansive portfolio that he's built in terms of what he delivered to the business.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这不一定改变。
subtitles.en: So that I think doesn't necessarily change.

subtitles.zh: 人们仍希望它存在，但希望某些方面更低调、更符合大众市场。
subtitles.en: People still want that to exist, but they want us some things to look a little more tuned down and a little more sanitized for the market at large.

briefs.speaker: Maribel Lopez
briefs.speaker_context: Founder and Principal Analyst, Lopez Research
briefs.current_title: Lopez Research：戴尔与HPE硬件分野，供应链能力定胜负

subtitles.zh: 你提到了模型领域面临的压力。
subtitles.en: You mentioned about the pressure we're seeing around the model space.

subtitles.zh: 那硬件领域呢？比如戴尔上调年度销售预期，称AI服务器需求强劲，但惠普却面临利润率担忧和零部件成本问题。
subtitles.en: What about the hardware space, right? Because I see a good story like Dell, raising their annual sales forecast, they talk about the AI server demand is strong, but then I pair that with what HPE was basically dealing

subtitles.zh: 你如何梳理当前的硬件领域？
subtitles.en: with is margin concerns and component costs as well. How do you kind of sift through the hardware space in the moment?

subtitles.zh: 我认为关键要看公司的供应链专业能力。
subtitles.en: I think one of the things you have to really look at is what is the supply chain expertise within a company?

subtitles.zh: 戴尔一直是供应链专家，比业内许多公司更能影响利润率。
subtitles.en: Dell has always been a supply chain expertise company. It has the ability to actually impact margins more so than a lot of other companies in the industry

subtitles.zh: 因为它长期参与零部件博弈，深谙此道。
subtitles.en: because it's really been playing the component game for a very, very long time and it knows how to do it well.

subtitles.zh: 所以根据交易时机和条款，这段时间利润率可能更好，我们都讨论过
subtitles.en: So depending on what deals you cut at what point in time, you could have much better margins for this period of time and we all had the discussion about what happened

subtitles.zh: 内存等方面的情况及其对市场的影响。
subtitles.en: with memory and other things and how that impacted the market.

subtitles.zh: 上周英特尔也讨论了PC需求等走向，但我觉得另一件
subtitles.en: I certainly saw that happen in Intel last week with a discussion about where PC demand and other things were going, but I really do think the other thing

subtitles.zh: 有趣的事是AI工厂的执行概念。
subtitles.en: that is really been interesting is the concept of the execution of the AI factory.

subtitles.zh: 如何将硬件引入企业，使其快速部署并创造价值？
subtitles.en: How do we get hardware into organizations in the way that they can get it up and running quickly so that they can deliver value?

subtitles.zh: 如果不采用云端方案，而是在本地构建AI工厂，戴尔和联想在该战略上执行得相当出色。
subtitles.en: So if you're not going to do it in the cloud, you're building an AI factory on prem and Dell and Lenovo have been executing on that strategy quite well.

subtitles.en: that actually down plated stock it actually released money for Anthropic stock.

subtitles.zh: 所以短期内对Anthropic有利。
subtitles.en: So that was actually good for Anthropic in the short term.

subtitles.zh: 长期来看，我们要担心的是基本面：未来能向企业收取多少AI模型费用，
subtitles.en: In the longer term, what we have to worry about is what are the fundamentals of how much can you charge enterprises for AI models going forward,

subtitles.zh: 尤其是亚洲出现了一些非常有吸引力的开放权重模型，而且相当不错。
subtitles.en: particularly with the fact that we've seen some very compelling models coming out of Asia that are Open Weight and are quite good.

subtitles.en: So that actually pushes pressure on the market not just for an Anthropic, but for Open AI and for anybody that develops models.

briefs.speaker: Maribel Lopez
briefs.speaker_context: Founder and Principal Analyst, Lopez Research
briefs.current_title: Lopez Research：IPO热潮退去，市场期待可持续增长

subtitles.zh: 他通常不会真的买入这些新股，因为你会看到初始上涨后便逐渐熄火。
subtitles.en: he usually isn't really a buyer of these IPOs because you see that initial pop and then things fizzle out.

subtitles.zh: 我认为他在这里把SpaceX作为一个重要例子。
subtitles.en: I think he put SpaceX as a big example of that here.

subtitles.zh: 那么，什么会吸引市场参与者重新回到这个领域呢？
subtitles.en: What sort of, what would entice I guess investors to kind of get back into that space?

subtitles.zh: 他们需要看到什么，才能让这类大型IPO维持住最初的涨势？
subtitles.en: What do they need to see in order for these kind of big IPOs to sustain those kind of initial rallies?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，不幸的是，我认为这里的一个真正问题是芯片市场出现了过度表现
subtitles.en: Well, unfortunately, one of the things I think is a real problem here is there has been such an overperformance in the chip market

subtitles.zh: 在过去大约八个季度里，现在市场参与者关注的是：我不希望你仅仅达到指引，我要你大幅超越指引
subtitles.en: over the past, say, eight quarters that right now what investors are looking at I don't want you to just meet guidance I want you to beat guidance by a significant amount

subtitles.zh: 而我认为这在软件销售中非常困难。
subtitles.en: and I think that's very hard in a software sale.

subtitles.zh: 在芯片销售中实际上更容易，因为购买者看重的是三年承诺，并且实际上在创造大量积压订单
subtitles.en: It's actually easier in a chip sale because the people that are buying these are looking at three year commit and they're actually creating extensive backlog

subtitles.zh: 在未来几年里。当您向企业销售软件时，看不到同样的积压订单情况。
subtitles.en: over the next several years. You don't see that same kind of backlog happening when you're selling software to enterprise this.

subtitles.zh: 有趣。好的，最后一个问题，Maribob想知道，就2027年而言，您会给客户什么样的建议，您会推荐在哪些方面
subtitles.en: Interesting. All right, last question Maribob is wondering in terms of 2027, what sort of the recommendations that you would give to client, what would you be recommending in terms of where

subtitles.zh: 现在来看明年L.A.I.交易中值得关注的点？
subtitles.en: to look at in this L.A.I. trade for next year now?

briefs.current_title: 麦格理Ellie Jiang：中国超大规模云厂商资本开支下调30%-40%，如何布局？

subtitles.zh: 更多内容，有请麦格理资本亚洲互联网与媒体研究主管Ellie John。
subtitles.en: For more, let's bring in Ellie John, Macquarie Capitals head of Asia Internet and Media Research.

subtitles.zh: 现在该怎么办？这几周市场波动很大。
subtitles.en: What to do now? It's been a crazy few weeks.

subtitles.zh: 确实如此。这段时间非常艰难，尤其是市场参与者面对全球各种混乱局面时。
subtitles.en: It did. It's been extremely difficult, especially when investors looking at all of these chaos happening around the world.

subtitles.zh: 对。我们被问得最多的是中国资本开支该怎么办。
subtitles.en: Right. The most question we've been getting is what to do with China CapEx.

subtitles.zh: 这些公司如何将AI相关资金投向未来，以及我们如何真正描绘未来的增长故事。
subtitles.en: How are these companies are investing their, you know, AI sort of dollars into the future and how do we really picture that future growth stories.

subtitles.zh: 我们注意到的一点是，这些中国超大规模企业多年来一直在多元化采购渠道。
subtitles.en: One thing we are noting is that these Chinese hyperscalers have been diversifying their procurement channels for many, many years.

subtitles.zh: 像阿里巴巴这样的公司，也拥有自己的专有技术领导力，这在一定程度上起到了防御作用。
subtitles.en: For companies like Alibaba, they also own their proprietary T headship that has been sort of defending a bit, right.

subtitles.zh: 面对未来的市场波动，我们已大幅下调主要BAT、百度、腾讯的资本开支预测约30%至40%，以反映持续的压力，尤其是2027、2028年。
subtitles.en: In terms of that future turbulence. But immediately we have been slashing our CapEx forecast across the major BAT, Bava, by Tenzen, by around 30 to 40 percent to factor that ongoing headwinds, especially in 227, 28.

subtitles.zh: 当然，相应地，数据中心工作量也会受到影响，因为可能我们看到超大规模企业的支出放缓。
subtitles.en: And of course, in response to that, the data center workload will also take a hit because potentially we are looking at a slower moving.

subtitles.zh: 对，来自超大规模企业的变化。那么现在该怎么做？
subtitles.en: Right from the hyperscalers. Now, what to do.

subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，当我们展望2027年时，我们仍然预计会有很多市场波动，尤其是外部的不确定性将持续一段时间。
subtitles.en: I mean, the idea that when we're looking at 2027 is that we still do anticipate a lot of turbulence, especially external, of altilities that will continue for some time.

subtitles.zh: 但同时，我们建议市场参与者回归基本原则，我们认为此时基本面更为重要。
subtitles.en: But at the same time, we're sort of recommending investors to return back to this investment 101, where we do think fundamental matters more at this point.

subtitles.zh: 在2027年，我们强调持久性的关键作用。
subtitles.en: In 227, we highlight the key work to our durability.

subtitles.zh: 我们认为，拥有稳定收益和较好现金流拐点的公司，例如CSP，可能有更充裕的现金余额来抵御未来几个月的市场波动。
subtitles.en: We think the companies that have steady earnings, disabilities have better cash flow inflection point, such as the CSPs potentially they have richer cash balance to really rather through the storm, right, in the coming month.

subtitles.zh: 因此，这确实是我们建议市场参与者在一定程度上避开持续外部波动的地方。
subtitles.en: So that is really a place that we recommend investors to somewhat hide from the ongoing external turbulence.

subtitles.zh: 你认为在美国监管方面，严格的审查仍将是最大的压力吗？
subtitles.en: Do you think when it comes to the US regulatory side of things, is the tightness scrutiny still going to be the biggest overhang?

briefs.current_title: 麦格理Ellie Jiang：美国监管压力下，中国AI全栈战略能否持续？
current_title_lines: 中国AI全栈战略能否持续？

subtitles.zh: 你认为在美国监管方面，严格的审查仍将是最大的隐患吗？
subtitles.en: Do you think when it comes to the US regulatory side of things, is the tightness scrutiny still going to be the biggest overhang?

subtitles.zh: 谈到你提到的这些超大规模企业，尽管，你知道，英伟达是否有黄仁勋？
subtitles.en: When it comes to some of these hyperscores that you talked about here, despite, you know, if NVIDIA has Jens Huang or not?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，这与黄仁勋无关。更多的是关于，嗯，有两件事。
subtitles.en: Well, it's not about Jens and Huang or not. It's more about how, well, there are two things.

subtitles.zh: 中国如何看待整个AI技术栈的未来发展？答案很简单，中国肯定致力于继续**AI。
subtitles.en: How is China viewing the entire AI stacks development going forward? And the answer is pretty simple, that China definitely is committed to continue investing in AI.

subtitles.zh: 他们想要高质量增长。所以最终，国家正试图管理发展节奏。
subtitles.en: They want quality growth. So eventually, the country is trying to manage the pace of the development.

subtitles.zh: 对于超大规模企业来说，当然，他们处于前沿。我的意思是，我们覆盖的大多数公司，包括Bob负责的腾讯，他们都在**所谓的全栈战略，对吧，所以他们有芯片，有，你知道，自己的云，有人工智能前沿模型等等。
subtitles.en: For the hyperscalers, of course, they are at the frontier. I mean, most majority of the company that we cover, including Bob on Tencent, they are investing this so-called full-stacks strategy, right, so they have chip, they have, you know,

subtitles.zh: 所以最终，我们仍然指望他们推动下一波增长或创新。所以我不认为这一点改变了。
subtitles.en: So eventually, we are still counting on them to drive the next wave of growth or innovation. So I don't think that is changed.

subtitles.zh: 确实在变化的是，外部环境越来越复杂，难以真正评估，对吧，甚至从公司的角度来看也是如此。
subtitles.en: What is changing is, indeed, for the external environments, it's getting a lot more complicated to really assess, right, even from the company's perspective.

subtitles.zh: 他们正试图真正暂停一下，可能只是降低近期的数字，以便在情况明朗之前对2027年有更好的看法。
subtitles.en: They are trying to really take a pause and potentially just bring down the numbers for the near term, so that they can have a better view on 2027 before things clear out.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为我们仍在经历那个真空期，27年是你看到国内库存尚未赶上，但显然我们已经在短期内失去了潜在的海外渠道。
subtitles.en: So I think we are still weathering through that vacuum period where 27 is where you see domestic stock has yet to catch up, but obviously we are already losing that potential overseas channels in the near term.

subtitles.zh: 我该怎么看，你提到过，也许超大规模厂商基本面更稳健一些，那硬件领域你怎么看？
subtitles.en: How should I be looking at, I mean, you talked about, right, you know, maybe it is the hyperscalers that, you know, fundamentals, I mean, maybe a little bit more sound versus like, I mean, how do you look at the hardware space?

briefs.speaker: Ellie Jiang
briefs.speaker_context: Ahead of Asia Internet and Media Research, CQ Capital (analyst)
briefs.current_title: 麦格理Ellie Jiang：中国互联网估值重估至8-9倍，底部在哪里？

subtitles.zh: 我该怎么看呢？你提到过，也许超大规模厂商的基本面稍好一些，那你怎么看硬件领域？
subtitles.en: How should I be looking at, I mean, you talked about, right, you know, maybe it is the hyperscalers that, you know, fundamentals, I mean, maybe a little bit more sound versus like, I mean, how do you look at the hardware space?

subtitles.zh: 因为我们已经看到这些权益资产经历了相当大的估值重估，但相比一些大型互联网平台，它们看起来仍然相当昂贵。
subtitles.en: Because we have seen quite a bit of evaluation reset on some of these stocks, but they're still looking quite expensive compared to, you know, some of the big internet platforms too.

subtitles.zh: 我认为最终在中国AI技术栈方面，关键在于精选优质标的。归根结底，这个领域仍处于发展的早期阶段。
subtitles.en: I think ultimately when it comes to China AI stack, it's all about quality selection. Ultimately, this is a space that is still in their early stage of the development.

subtitles.zh: 所以可以说，当我们看中国超大规模厂商的资本开支比美国落后两年时，国内技术栈可能还要更晚，对吧？
subtitles.en: So you could argue that when we look at the Chinese hyperscalers running their CapEx 2 years behind the US, the domestic stack is probably even later than that, right?

subtitles.zh: 这也得到了许多政府实体的支持，包括资本注入和地方支持。
subtitles.en: And this is also being blessed by a lot of the governments from entities in terms of capital injection, in terms of the local support.

subtitles.zh: 所以最终从市场参与者角度看，观察这个内部格局时，看到国内技术栈逐渐赶上并在整体AI技术栈贡献中占据更大份额，当然是有建设性的。
subtitles.en: So eventually from investors perspective, when you're looking at this internal landscape, of course, it's pretty constructive that we are seeing domestic stack gradually catches up and taking a larger portion within the total AI stack contr

subtitles.zh: 但在未来两到三年里，优质标的将最为重要。
subtitles.en: But when we are sort of going through in the next two to three years, the quality names would matter the most.

subtitles.zh: 所以再次回到这个观点：你应该更关注自由现金流的可见性，以及公司是否有足够能力真正实现自筹资金，对吧？
subtitles.en: So again, coming back to the idea of, you know, you should be really focusing more on this free cash flow of visibility and whether the companies have enough capability to really sell fund, right?

subtitles.zh: 如果情况不太顺利，现在什么能提供底部支撑？
subtitles.en: If things don't really go well. What could put a floor on this right now?

subtitles.zh: 这总是最难的问题。
subtitles.en: That's always the hardest question.

subtitles.zh: 中国互联网公司的底部在哪里，尤其是考虑到它们一直以如此低迷的估值倍数交易？
subtitles.en: What is the floor for Chinese internet names, especially given that they have been trading at such a distressed multiple?

subtitles.zh: 当我们看这个板块时，整个板块的估值倍数基本上回到2023年左右的12倍水平。
subtitles.en: When we look at our sector, the entire sector multiple is basically retrieving back to around 2023, 12-level.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们说的是大约8到9倍远期市盈率的混合平均值。
subtitles.en: So we're talking about a blended average of around 8 to 9 times forward P.

subtitles.zh: 所以即使放在全球背景下，这也相当便宜。
subtitles.en: So it's quite cheap, even if you put it in the global context.

subtitles.zh: 接下来会发生什么，第一，我认为股东回报是人们关心的事情。
subtitles.en: Now, what's happening going forward is one, I think shareholder return is something that people care.

subtitles.zh: 尤其是在不确定时期，人们实际上更欣赏那种有保证的回报。
subtitles.en: Especially in the times of uncertainty, people actually appreciate more in terms of that guaranteed return.

subtitles.zh: 第二，这些公司能否真正找到盈利的支撑位。
subtitles.en: Two is whether these companies can really find a support level for the earnings.

subtitles.zh: 事实上，随着BIS和外部方面所有这些持续变化，我们看到，例如腾讯可能看到盈利下调的谷底。
subtitles.en: And in fact, with all of these ongoing changes from BIS, from the external side, we are seeing, for example, Tencent potentially seeing the trough of that earnings downward revision.

subtitles.zh: 所以在2027年，我们可能会看到下半年他们的自由现金流可能转回正值。
subtitles.en: So in 2027, we might see into second half their free cash flow could turn back to positive.

subtitles.zh: 这也可能成为推动这只权益资产的关键催化剂。
subtitles.en: That could also serve as a key catalyst to drive this stock as well.

subtitles.zh: 好的，除了互联网平台，在盈利方面你还关注哪些？
subtitles.en: Okay, beyond just the internet platforms, what else are you tracking in terms of the earnings side of things?

briefs.speaker: Ellie Jiang
briefs.speaker_context: Ahead of Asia Internet and Media Research, CQ Capital (analyst)
briefs.current_title: 麦格理Ellie Jiang：宏观压力下，互联网公司盈利韧性从何而来？

subtitles.zh: 除了互联网平台，在盈利方面你还关注什么？
subtitles.en: Okay, beyond just the internet platforms, what else are you tracking in terms of the earnings side of things?

subtitles.zh: 宏观因素无法回避。
subtitles.en: Macro is something that you just cannot avoid.

subtitles.zh: 我们都看到了消费股和互联网股的表现。
subtitles.en: We have all seen all the consumer stocks, all the internet stocks as well.

subtitles.zh: 最终，宏观环境并不太理想。
subtitles.en: Eventually, Macro is not too great.

subtitles.zh: 我们仍在努力应对全球市场持续的通货紧缩影响。
subtitles.en: We're still trying to sort of weather through the ongoing deflationary impact from the global market.

subtitles.zh: 事实上，互联网公司往往更具韧性，因为它们已经存在了很长时间。
subtitles.en: The truth is, for the internet names, they tend to be a bit more resilient, just given that they have been around for a very long time.

subtitles.zh: 它们懂得如何应对。事实上，像阿里甚至拼多多这样的公司，令人惊讶的是，尽管近期宏观逆风，我们看到它们的核心电商盈利能力在最近财报中找到了支撑。
subtitles.en: They know how to play the game. In fact, for the likes of Baba, or even PDD, what's surprising is that despite of recent macro headwings, we're seeing their core e-commerce profitability finding a support in the recent earnings.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我们认为这些也可能是市场参与者会追踪到2027年的因素，即使宏观环境不佳。
subtitles.en: So we do think these could be also things that investors track into 2027, where even Macro is bad.

subtitles.zh: 总会有一些因素支撑这些公司如何继续保持安全。
subtitles.en: There will always be something to support in terms of how these companies can continue safe.

subtitles.zh: 在内部开支方面，它们如何潜在地优化研发。
subtitles.en: In terms of their internal expenses, how they can potentially optimize on R&D as well.

subtitles.zh: 这些都能让你对盈利更有信心，尤其是在2027年。
subtitles.en: All of that can give you more confidence on earnings particularly in 2027.

subtitles.zh: 我看了他们的覆盖范围。
subtitles.en: I looked at their coverage.

subtitles.zh: 汇丰中国科技与汽车研究主管Yu Chen-Deng，感谢你的参与。
subtitles.en: But their take, HSBC's head of China technology and auto's research, Yu Chen-Deng, you're doing this great to have you.

subtitles.zh: 为何股价对财报反应积极？主要因智能手机利润率韧性。
subtitles.en: Why do you think the stock is reacting so positively to these earnings? So mostly because of the quality smartphone margin resilience.

subtitles.zh: 这是关键焦点。市场曾担忧内存涨价持续压制消费电子，
subtitles.en: So I think that has been the key focus. Market used to be worried about the higher memory price has been continuous due pressure down the consumer electronics,

subtitles.zh: 尤其是智能手机。但小米三季度证明其利润率。
subtitles.en: especially the smartphones. But the Xiaomi's third quarter demonstrated they do have the margin.

subtitles.zh: 他们证明在压力下利润率强劲，得益于提价和产品结构优化。
subtitles.en: They do demonstrate strong margin resilience under these pressure thanks to higher pricing and also a better mix.

subtitles.zh: 你预计内存价格周期未来如何？
subtitles.en: How do you foresee where memory prices of the cycle goes moving forward?

subtitles.zh: 有见顶迹象吗？从小米角度看，压力可能仍存。
subtitles.en: Have you seen signs of that peaking now? So we would say from a Xiaomi perspective, the pressure might still remain.

subtitles.zh: 2027年及未来几年，内存涨价可能更高，
subtitles.en: So for the 2027, for the few years, the memory price inflation might be getting higher now,

subtitles.zh: 但压力仍在。供需结构改善可能要到2028年。
subtitles.en: but the pressure remains due there. So for the supply demand situation to get in structure lease, that could be 2028.

subtitles.zh: 未来几个季度，成本压力持续。
subtitles.en: So for the coming a few quarters, the cost of pressure remains.

subtitles.zh: 电动汽车业务呢？
subtitles.en: What about for the EV business, right?

briefs.speaker: Yu Chen-Deng
briefs.speaker_context: HSBC, Head of China Technology and Auto Research
briefs.current_title: 汇丰余晨登：内地车市需求走弱，小米电动车为何不慌？

subtitles.zh: 电动车业务呢？中国整体汽车市场的增长势头明显放缓。
subtitles.en: What about for the EV business, right? We're starting to see momentum really slow down when it comes to the wider China auto market.

subtitles.zh: 小米在这种环境下表现如何？今年小米一直做得很好。
subtitles.en: How does Xiaomi fare in that environment now? Yeah, so this year I would say, for Xiaomi lately, they've been doing really well.

subtitles.zh: 这两款车型稳步上量，四季度环比来看，电动车销量强劲，支撑销量
subtitles.en: The two models from this kind of matter has been ramping up well. So corner on quarter into the fourth quarter, we do see a strong EV volume to support both on the volume

subtitles.zh: 以及定价和利润率。
subtitles.en: and also pricing as well as margin perspective.

subtitles.zh: 我们对小米不太担心，但整体市场则是另一番景象。
subtitles.en: We're not too worried for Xiaomi. But for the overall market, there's a different picture.

subtitles.zh: 今年的需求，整体汽车市场需求下降约20%。
subtitles.en: So this year's demand, here today, overall car market demand down by low 20%.

subtitles.zh: 电动车也下降约10%，是近年来表现较差的一年。
subtitles.en: So EV is also down by low 10%. So it's one of the worst year we're having.

subtitles.zh: 整体需求未见好转，但我们要强调，明年一季度销售时
subtitles.en: So overall demand picture is not getting any better, but we do want to highlight when we sell into first quarter next year.

subtitles.zh: 月度、年度数据将改善。国际扩张怎么看？欧盟等地已有所动作
subtitles.en: The monthly, young year is going to improve. How do you look at international expansion now now that we have seen the likes of EU

subtitles.zh: 现在又谈到美国？显然他们不会。
subtitles.en: and we're talking about the US right now? I mean, obviously, they don't.

subtitles.zh: 美国市场仅有中国电动汽车，但关税问题再次被提及。
subtitles.en: Just have EV cars, the Chinese EV cars in the US, but we're talking about tariffs once again.

subtitles.zh: 你认为它们能依靠海外扩张来抵消国内市场的疲软吗？
subtitles.en: Do you think they can rely on overseas expansion to offset maybe the weakness in domestically?
